metadata.title: Project Accounting | AdonERP
metadata.description: AI-powered project accounting platform — track budgets, costs, milestone billing, and profitability for every project in real time.

hero.title: Project
hero.description: Plan project budgets, track real costs as they happen, and bill clients accurately — all from one connected workspace.

items.title: Budget vs. actual.
items.description: Set a budget per project, then watch actual labor, material, and overhead costs post against it live.

items.title: Cost breakdown.
items.description: See exactly where spend is going — timesheets, purchases, expenses, and subcontractor bills, all in one ledger.

items.title: Flexible billing.
items.description: Bill fixed-price, time & material, or milestone-based — whatever fits the contract.

dashboardSection.title: Track costs the moment they happen

collaborationSection.title: Bill clients
collaborationSection.description: Trigger invoices automatically when a milestone is reached, a percentage of completion is hit, or a billing period closes.

timesheetSection.title: Time is money
timesheetSection.description: Timesheets, expenses, and purchases post straight to project costs, so billable hours and reimbursable spend never get lost.

progressSection.title: Always know a
progressSection.subtitle: project's margin
progressSection.description: Profitability updates in real time — revenue billed, costs incurred, and margin per project, without waiting for month-end close.

features.title: Budget management
features.description: Set and revise budgets by cost category for each project.

features.title: Cost allocation
features.description: Automatically post timesheets, purchases, and expenses to the right project.

features.title: Milestone billing
features.description: Invoice on completion percentage, fixed milestones, or time & material.

features.title: Profitability reporting
features.description: Get real-time margin, WIP, and variance reports per project.

features.title: Revenue recognition
features.description: Recognize revenue against billed and unbilled work automatically.

planningDemo.title: Budget planning
planningDemo.description: Plan project budgets, cost categories, and billing milestones from one visual workspace.

ctaBanner.title: Join 15 million users
ctaBanner.description: who grow their business with Adon

testimonial.quote: Adon gives us real-time visibility into project margins — we stopped finding out we lost money until it was too late.
testimonial.name: Tyrone Miller
